C1166.title: API Enumeration Techniques in a Network Engineer's Theft of Gambling Site Funds
C1166.summary: Network engineer Li Dong exploited a server program vulnerability in an overseas gambling website to steal personal information, identify high-rebate agent accounts, and replace their rebate bank accounts. The report did not disclose the specific vulnerability type or data acquisition method, so it should not be stated as SQL injection, unauthorized access, database export, or packet interception as confirmed technical paths. Police in two locations seized 183 bitcoins in the case.
